{{Quote|Mynocks. Probably chewing on the power cables.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Mynocks''' were a [[Bat/Legends|bat]]-like [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]]-based space-dwelling [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that could be found across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were often seen leeching power from [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] and could absorb matter from a ship's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] causing it to breach, and if not caught in time, cause catastrophic failure.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Look, General&mdash;''mynocks''!''"<br />"''I see them! ''Miraculous beings''&hellip; One of the few creatures able to survive the ''cold vacuum of space''.''"<br />"''Best not to get too close, General&mdash;they'll eat through our ''power cables'' as soon as look at us!|[[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Outgunned">{{TCWComicCite|6.20|Outgunned}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mynock.png|thumb|left|180px|A mynock attached to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].]]
The mynock was a [[Leather/Legends|leathery]], [[Color/Legends|black]]-skinned flying creature resembling a [[manta ray]]. They were vacuumbreathers, capable of surviving in extremely cold extraplanetary environments.<ref name="New Alien" /> Mynocks had bat-like wings with clawed tips,<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> which they could use to fly in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]], however, they were mostly limited to the vacuum of space due to an [[Allergy/Legends|allergy]] to [[Helium/Legends|helium]] found in the atmosphere of many [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. This allergic reaction would cause them to inflate and nearly explode before dying. Many spacewalking sport hunters would kill mynocks by attaching helium-based grenades to them in what was called "[[Mynock Puffing]]."<ref name="New Alien" /> 

[[File:Mynock_TofG.jpg|thumb|220px|Mynocks attaching themselves to the hull of a [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]]]]
They fed on electrical, stellar, and electromagnetic energy, and would thus attach themselves to power cables or ion ports on ships and structures. The energy was absorbed through a specialized, suction-cup-like organ<ref name="New Alien" /><ref name="A Guide to the SWU" /> resembling a big sucker-like mouth located between their eye stalks. In space, mynocks traveled by riding stellar winds, to capture energy emitted by stars, absorbing radiation with their skin. After gathering enough energy, creatures would find an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] to land, and attached themselves to various surfaces, consuming [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]] and other materials, to acquire enough extra mass for [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]].<ref name="New Alien" />

Mynocks had very few internal organs, and their biological makeup resembled that of single-celled organisms.<ref name="New Alien" /> In place of [[Bone/Legends|bones]], mynocks had cartilage beneath the flesh.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> Similarly to most single-celled micro-organisms, mynocks [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduced]] by ''mitosis'',<ref name="New Alien" /> however they were also known to lay [[Egg/Legends|eggs]].<ref name="Dantooine Egg crate">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|A crate of "Mynock eggs" can be found at the [[Sporefall]] forward camp on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> When reproducing, mynocks spawned [[Larva/Legends|larvae]] on planetary surfaces.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" />

Some mynocks had yellow eyes, and had shiny spore sacs that could distend. They had [[stingray]]-like tails and poison [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> Some Mynocks had legs, while others were legless,{{Fact}} some dragging themselves along by their ventral sucker-disk.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> 

[[File:Mynock-FF75.png|thumb|left|180px|A two-mouthed variant of mynock]]
Mynocks were distantly related to [[xuvva]]s.<ref name="xuvva">{{TORcite|type=codex|Xuvva}}</ref> A few (sub)species of mynocks existed, including one that had a normal mouth, rather than a sucker-like one, and another that had blue skin and gave birth to live young. Subspecies of mynocks included the [[salt mynock]] and [[sulfur mynock]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], the atmosphere-breathing [[Vynock/Legends|Vynock]] that lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the [[Tatooine mynock]], and the Talusian [[Fynock]]<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies" />. Atmosphere-breathing mynocks also lived on [[Imdaar/Legends|Imdaar]] and were known to attack those piloting speeder bikes through the planet's swamps.<ref name="Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref> A group of [[The Home mynock|sentient mynocks]], related to mynocks, evolved on a lone [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[MZX32905 system/Legends|MZX32905 system]] near [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]].<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref> [[Snow Mynock]]s were found on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="SSTWESB" />

[[Mynock Fever]] was a disease that could affect travelers that passed in or near asteroid belts where mynock inhabited. Authorities recommended vaccinations to prevent the fever.<ref name="Passport">''[[The Star Wars Intergalactic Passport]]''</ref>

==Behavior==
Mynocks were considered to be the [[Rat/Legends|rats]] of space, attaching themselves to [[Starship/Legends|starships]], usually in [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]], which allowed them to travel between [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> Mynocks traveled through space in packs,<ref name="ESB OCE">''[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back - Official Collectors Edition]]''</ref> and tended to flock together in a pack of ten, though they could migrate annually in large groups. The most notable of these migrations were the famed migrations of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]], where the sky could literally become darkened from swarms of these creatures.{{Fact}} Mynocks were extremely territorial creatures, however temporal their locales might be. They attacked intruders in larger numbers if they felt threatened, displaying the ability to communicate. Scientists speculated if they interacted using [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]], [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]], or even through a primitive from of a [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]]. Outside of the soundless environment of space, mynocks could produce a loud, piercing screech.<ref name="New Alien" />

Mynocks were believed to collapse and die rapidly if subjected to planet-sized [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" />

Mynocks were [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]]<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> parasites, and attached to prey using their suction-cup-like organ.<ref name="A Guide to the SWU" /> They were commonly eaten by another silicon-based creature, the [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorth]], and were the favorite prey of [[tailring]]s, who devoured them with voracious relish. Swarms of mynocks could be found alive, flying around a space slug's innards for an extended period of time before digestion began. While living in a slug, they could obtain sustenance by feeding on its veins and intestinal lining. Despite being a silicon-based lifeform, a properly prepared mynock could also be ingested by [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]-based life forms;<ref name="MW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}</ref> they were sometimes used in [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] cuisine, such as [[Mynock Coronet City/Legends|Mynock Coronet City]]. However, they were usually seen as a last resort meal by converting their flesh into [[bioplasma]] for space stations or colonists, albeit low quality and bitter tasting rations.

==History==
{{Quote|They're mynocks, you simpering groundlubber! You're supposed to shake them off in orbit! Now you've violated planetary quarantine, and you'll have to take care of it yourself.|[[Teguta Lusat]] Ground Control, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" />}}
It was speculated that mynocks may have originated in the [[Mynockra system|system]] of [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]], however the true planet of their origin was unknown. According to [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]], mynocks may have evolved in the vaccum of space.<ref name="New Alien" />

Mynocks often attached themselves to passing starships to chew on power cables. A drop in the power of the hyperdrive could increase the travel time.<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> They were considered [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]] by pilots and starport personnel, and failure to properly shake them off in orbit before landing could result in quarantine.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], some factions within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] used mynocks as nuisance tactics against the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial space fleet]]. When the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] learned about hidden mynock incubation facilities, they sent agents to level the buildings.<ref name="SWG:Cami">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Imperial|Crush a mynock incubator}}</ref>

==Mynocks in the galaxy==
{{Quote|So long as those ''droid brains'' are in control we're sitting mynocks! The ''Falcon'' won't respond to my commands.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="MSME">{{SWComicCite|7.7|My Spaceship, My Enemy}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mynock-SSW.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] mynock.]]
Because mynocks were generally considered to be loathsome pests, the word "mynock" was used as a disparaging term. However, in recognition of the mynock's skill at evading attack, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] named a form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] after the beast: [[Form III/Legends|Soresu]]. [[Cade Skywalker]] also had a starship called [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']]. [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Ben Skywalker]], and [[Toval Seyah]] used the code name, Team Mynock, on their mission to infiltrate the Centerpoint Station.

Mynocks were believed to have little charisma, and irritating people were sometimes compared to mynocks.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> "Son of a mynock" was an insult.<ref name="sons of mynocks!">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|The Defense of Fort Tonvarr|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>

Mynocks were spiced and eaten at some times by the Twi'leks, in a way that was reportedly considered good-tasting by other species, although this seems unlikely unless these other species are also silicon based, given that silicon based and carbon based biochemistries are incompatible.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Is it your nock or mynock?|A [[bitizen]] through the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]|<ref name="TinyDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>}}
Mynocks were first introduced in the [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]].
